title: Open candidate alpha PNG in installed Kinovea

input.provenance: Synthetic transparent fixture from the Windows .NET Framework 4.8 Bitmap characterization candidate. Candidate is not an approved golden baseline.

preconditions: Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix and matching Kinovea executable.
No Kinovea window may already be open.
Xwayland display must be reachable from the harness.

actions.description: Use Kinovea's Ctrl+O dialog to open the specified fixture from a blank disposable workspace.
Capture after opening the PNG through the actual file-picker workflow.
Close the current player screen using the production Ctrl+F4 shortcut.
Capture the remaining application window after closing the screen.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Confirm the app displays the opened PNG as a still-image frame.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Review the application window and visible reader controls after the dialog closes.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Confirm the image presentation follows the 13x9 source aspect ratio.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Review the image bounds in the captured application window.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Confirm transparent and partially transparent regions have a visible presentation.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Review the screenshot against the application background; this is not an alpha-byte measurement.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Confirm Ctrl+F4 closes the opened image screen while leaving Kinovea open.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Compare the application window before and after close.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 to the Kinovea window it launched; it never calls wineserver -k.
evidenceConfidence: Low until human review; screenshots cannot establish decoded pixels, alpha bytes, or reader selection.
limitations: Screenshot cannot establish alpha byte values, premultiplication, or exact aspect ratio.
Candidate Windows fixture is pending human approval.
